notes: kb/Work/PB415.md - ALL FOUR DIVERGENCES CLOSED, re-measured on the licensed PDF's printed page (p667 = folio 637, rendered). (1) category-name is now the SET the figure draws: the grammar rule `initializeCategory : initializeCategoryName+` over a total 13-alternative `initializeCategoryName`, so 5.2.6.4's 'one or more of the alternatives ... any single alternative ... only once' holds and `REPLACING NUMERIC ALPHANUMERIC DATA BY SPACE` compiles - at COBOL-85 too, which conformance:cases/14.9.20-INITIALIZE/pb415_initialize_multi_category_85 pins (the five classic words are '85 words). BOOLEAN / DATA-POINTER / NATIONAL-EDITED / OBJECT-REFERENCE gained lexer tokens with cobol-words.json nameSlot rows, so each stays a legal user word below its 8.9 reservation; the eight post-85 words are gated per word at their own reservation edition by VersionConformancePass.VisitInitializeCategoryName (constructs initialize-category-2002 / -2014 / -2023), witnessed by conformance:cases/14.9.20-INITIALIZE/pb415-initialize-category-national-85. (2) TO was already an optional word in both phrases (kb/Work PB695 family 2), re-verified here. (3) The over-acceptance is gone: the {ALL | category-name} brace is mandatory per 5.2.6.3 and a bare TO VALUE is COBOL1981 (conformance:cases/14.9.20-INITIALIZE/pb415-initialize-value-bare-choice); tests/conformance/2002/initialize_phrases.cob, which PINNED the over-acceptance green, now spells ALL TO VALUE and its .out is unchanged - ALL was always the meaning the omission was silently given. (4) The non-standard two-word `ALPHANUMERIC EDITED` / `NUMERIC EDITED` spellings are gone, and with them the hard EDITED lexer token that was their only consumer: EDITED is not an ISO 8.9 reserved word at any edition (no reserved-words.json row) and the token had made `01 EDITED PIC X.` a COBOL0001 at every edition. The FOURTEENTH category name would be one enum member plus one grammar alternative - InitializeLaneDriftTests pins the grammar rule, the enum and the edition bands against reserved-words.json, and BOTH failure branches were fired before the tests were trusted.
